description: This file defines a class for conversation summary memory node, including methods for initializing, retrieving chat messages, and managing memory, integrating with external memory and chat models.

classes.name: ConversationSummaryMemory_Memory
classes.description: A node class implementing conversation summary memory with methods for initialization and message retrieval.

classes.name: ConversationSummaryMemoryExtended

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the memory node with provided data and options, returning a ConversationSummaryMemoryExtended instance.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from the database, optionally prepending messages and returning summarized or base messages.

methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, managed on server level.

methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, managed on server level.
